declaredIdentity: Tenant / examination-signoffs / signOffId; first accepted content immutable; same initial content/actor/role/time retry; handler reuses retained SignedOffAt. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
invariant: One final personal management decision binds exact package/assertion/letter/outcome and acknowledges exactly every unresolved material item.
boundaryRationale: Known exceptions and acknowledgements form one accepted decision capsule; splitting them would permit signing a different set. Referenced source lifecycles stay independent.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record

baselineIdentityObservation: Tenant / examination-signoffs / signOffId; first accepted content immutable; same initial content/actor/role/time retry; handler reuses retained SignedOffAt. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant / examination-signoffs / SignOffId, with exact examination, package/snapshot, signer and role binding. SignOffId is the selected immutable creation identity.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant / examination-signoffs / SignOffId, with exact examination, package/snapshot, signer and role binding. SignOffId is the selected immutable creation identity.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: Package sign-off sequence is fixed: the package is validated, then the assertion is signed, then the representation letter is signed, then the outcome is recorded.

decides: Refuses out-of-order package sign-off: the package must be validated first, then the assertion signed, then the representation letter signed, and only then is the outcome recorded.
